environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service consuming from the same SQS queue. Messages originate from an API Gateway (REST API) endpoint POST /events. The API Gateway resource has a RequestValidator with validateRequestBody=true attached, referencing a Model (content-type application/json) defined with a JSON Schema draft-04 document. The schema specifies 'additionalProperties: false' at root level, with required properties ['payload', 'correlation_id', 'tenant_id'] all typed as 'string', and explicitly does NOT include 'headers' as an allowed property. The integration request uses a VTL mapping template that reconstructs the body from $input.json('$.payload'), $input.json('$.correlation_id'), and $input.json('$.tenant_id') only — any fields not in the schema are stripped before the Lambda publisher receives them. The Lambda publisher also only extracts these three fields when constructing the SQS SendMessage call.

config.api_gateway_model: JSON Schema: {type: object, required: [payload, correlation_id, tenant_id], properties: {payload: {type: string, maxLength: 4096}, correlation_id: {type: string, pattern: '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$'}, tenant_id: {type: string, pattern: '^tenant-[a-z0-9]{8}$'}}, additionalProperties: false}
config.integration_mapping: VTL template reconstructs body from validated fields only
config.lambda_publisher: Extracts only payload, correlation_id, tenant_id; publishes structured message to SQS
config.sqs_queue: Standard queue, messages only contain validated fields
config.grpc_backend: Same trust model for metadata headers
